ed.newSub: Two things are required. Everything else can wait, or never happen.
ed.editSub: Made {date} · {stories, plural, one {# story} other {# stories}}
ed.missingBody: A name and how they say hi. Everything else can stay empty.
ed.editNoteBody: Stories that already have {name} keep who {p, select, she {she was} he {he was} other {they were}} when they started. What {p, select, she {she} he {he} other {they}} said stays as written.
ed.faceSub: Drop an image, pick one from Kataki’s set, or leave it. They get an initial until you decide.
ed.name: Name
ed.nameHint: What you call them. You can change it later.
ed.nameErr: Give them a name. It’s the one thing Kataki can’t guess.
ed.nameTaken: Someone called {name} is already here. That’s allowed. NAME_TAKEN
ed.hiHint: Their first line in every new story. Actions go between *asterisks*.
ed.hiErr: Write how they say hi. It’s their first line in every new story.
ed.hiPlaceholder: *sets the bucket down, wipes her hands* Back gate’s locked again.
ed.g.warm: *looks up and smiles* There you are. I saved you the good seat.
ed.g.guarded: *doesn’t look up* We’re closed. Unless you’ve got a reason to be here.
ed.g.hurry: *already halfway out the door* Walk with me. I’ve got four minutes and you’ve got questions.
ed.g.argue: *turns, mid-sentence* — and that’s exactly what I told them. Oh. You heard all that, didn’t you?
ed.optional: Optional · add any of these whenever
ed.aboutSub: What anyone would see. Two or three lines is plenty.
ed.aboutHint: Everyone who meets them could notice this. Characters read it every turn.
ed.tagsHint: Up to three, with commas between.
ed.talkSub: Two sample lines. This does more than anything else here.
ed.secretSub: Something only they know. It changes how they answer.
ed.secretHint: Only this character knows it. They never say it unless the story earns it.
ed.relsSub: Who they already know, and how they feel about them.
ed.placesSub: Pick from your World, or write a new one.
ed.model: Which model plays them, and how they remember
ed.modelSub: Leave it and they use the defaults in Settings.
ed.modelHint: Only models that are connected now are listed.
ed.ready.draft: A name and a greeting is enough to play. {name} stays a draft until you give {p, select, she {her} he {him} other {them}} a secret.
ed.ready.full: Everything that matters is here. {name} is ready for a story.
ed.ready.noBody: A name and a greeting is all it takes.
ed.ready.edit: {p, select, she {She stays} he {He stays} other {They stay}} the same person
ed.ready.editBody: Edits change who {p, select, she {she is} he {he is} other {they are}} from now on, not what already happened.
